statistical_criterion.rule: For each strategy and layer, both the lexical-adjusted held-out-domain direction-alignment and projection-margin cluster bootstrap lower bounds exceed zero; Bonferroni controls familywise error across all sampled checkpoint x layer x strategy tests. Earliest sampled checkpoint satisfying the rule is reported; no exact emergence time is inferred.

interpretation_boundary: This study measures strategy-related information in residual streams. It does not show that those representations cause cooperative decisions or establish a cooperative preference.
